data.title: 蕾塞 · 街角咖啡馆·柜台托腮与狡黠微笑
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 街角咖啡馆·柜台托腮与狡黠微笑】阳光透过木格窗洒在街角十字路口的复古咖啡馆里，穿着围裙的蕾塞单手托腮趴在木质吧台前。她歪着头看向推门而入的电次，紫发在光影中跳跃，绽放出纯真又狡黠的明媚笑容——「电次君！今天又来找我喝咖啡了吗？要是每天都来的话，我可是会误以为你喜欢上我了哦。」
data.promptProse: Reze props her chin on one hand across the cafe counter, giving the viewer a playful mischievous smile above her barista apron, rolled-sleeve shirt and denim trousers. The medium portrait includes the espresso machine beside her and tables extending behind the glass facade. Warm afternoon window light illuminates her face and the counter edge, reflecting brightly from the machine's metal panels while the lower counter stays gently shaded.
